chunks: That is how We have revealed this Book to you and those to whom We have sent down the Book will believe in it. Only those who are infidels will deny it.

key_terms.الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ: Those to whom We gave the Book (People of the Book)

ai.seo_question: Who believes in the Quran according to Surah Al-Ankabut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of divine revelation, affirming that the Quran fulfills the prophecies of the Torah and Gospel, thereby validating the faith of the Ahl al-Kitab. It highlights a universal truth where belief is not limited to a specific lineage, contrasting the sincere believers with the stubborn disbelievers who reject clear signs despite their knowledge.
